description.value: Fernie Mountain Spirits is a well-stocked liquor store on 7th Avenue in the heart of Fernie, offering over 350 wines, a curated sour beer selection (helpfully marked with orange labels), a wide range of imports and domestics, and an impressive tequila selection. Located in a popular mountain-biking and cycling hub, it's a natural resupply stop for touring cyclists looking to pick up cold beer or wine for the campsite or the next leg of the journey.
